title: Write professionally
prompt:
Rewrite the text below so it reads as professional, clear and friendly. Keep my meaning and every fact, name and date exactly. Use short paragraphs and plain words, no jargon. Give the rewritten text first, then one line on what you changed.

Text:
[paste or type your text]

detail: a fact you did not know
title: Surprise me
prompt: Surprise me with one fascinating, little-known fact about [a topic you like, or anything]. Explain it in three short paragraphs: the fact, why it is true, and one place I could notice it in everyday life. Keep it friendly and under 150 words.

title: What time is it?
prompt: What time is it right now?

title: Plan my day
prompt: Plan my day. Here is what I need to do today: [your tasks, meetings and errands]. I start at [8:00] and want to finish by [18:00]. Put the hardest task when I am freshest, group small errands, and add short breaks and lunch. Answer with a time-blocked schedule as a simple list, then one tip to stay on track.

title: Write a message
prompt: Help me write a message. Ask me who it is for and what I want to say, then write a short draft I can send.

title: What can you do?
prompt: What can you do in this app? Answer in a few short lines, each with an example I can try right away.

title: Learn Spanish
prompt: I want to learn Spanish. My level is [beginner, intermediate or advanced] and I can study [30 minutes] a day. Build me a 7-day plan. For each day give: a theme, 8 useful words with example sentences, one short grammar point with two examples, and a 5-minute speaking or writing exercise. End with a 10-question quiz that mixes all days, with the answers at the very bottom.

title: Explain simply
prompt: Explain [a topic] in simple words, as if I am new to it. Start with a one-sentence summary, then an everyday analogy, then a short step-by-step explanation, and end with three common misunderstandings. No jargon; if you need a term, define it in a few words.

title: Quiz me
prompt: Quiz me on world geography. Ask one question at a time, wait for my answer, tell me if I was right, and raise the difficulty after every two correct answers.

detail: three weeks, an hour a day
title: Exam study plan
prompt: I have an exam in 3 weeks and 1 hour per weekday to study. Ask me for the subject and my weak topics first, then build a week-by-week plan with review sessions and a final mock test.

title: Reply to this
prompt:
Write a reply to the message below. Tone: {tone}. Language: {language}. Give the reply text only, with no introduction and no notes.

Message:

choices.title: Short

title: Cover letter
prompt: Help me write a one-page cover letter. Ask me five short questions about the role and my background, then write the letter in a warm, direct tone without clichés.

title: Short story
prompt: Write a 400-word short story about a lighthouse keeper who finds a message in a bottle. Give it a twist ending and a title.

title: Summarize text
prompt:
Summarize the text below in three bullet points, then in one sentence, then list any open questions it leaves.

Text:

title: What is this text?
prompt:
Explain the text below in plain words: what it is, what it means, and anything I should do about it.

Text:

title: Plan my week
prompt: Help me plan my week. Ask me about my fixed commitments, goals and energy levels, then propose a day-by-day schedule with focus blocks, breaks and one buffer slot per day.

detail: a relaxed city break for two
title: 3-day trip
prompt: Plan a relaxed 3-day city trip for two people on a mid-range budget. Ask me for the city and interests first, then give a morning, afternoon and evening plan per day with rough costs.

title: Meal prep
prompt: Create a 5-day vegetarian meal prep plan with about 100 g of protein per day. Include a shopping list grouped by aisle and simple reheating instructions.

title: Weigh a decision
prompt: Help me decide between two options. Ask me what they are and what matters most, then make a pros and cons table, score each option, and give a recommendation with the main risk.

detail: line by line, with its bugs
title: Explain this code
prompt:
Explain what the code below does, line by line in plain language, then point out any bugs or edge cases.

Code:

detail: find the cause step by step
title: Debug with me
prompt: I have a bug. Ask me for the error message, the code and what I expected, then walk me through likely causes from most to least probable and how to check each one.

title: Write a regex
prompt: Write a regular expression that matches valid 24-hour times like 07:45 and 23:59. Explain each part and give five matching and five non-matching examples.

detail: ten ideas, from safe to bold
title: Brainstorm ideas
prompt: Brainstorm 10 ideas for [what you need ideas for]. Make them varied, from safe to bold. For each, give a one-line pitch and the first small step to try it. End by naming the two you would pick and why.
